co ground state interpretationTetrahedral 4A2 has no orbital angular momentum. Out-of-state spin–orbit coupling gives a small positive zero-field splitting and explains nested S=3/2 saturation curves.author derivedSource-reported observationcoschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 12, printed p. 13216, IV.D.iv
cited nickel ground multiplet excitation160 cm^-1reportedSource-reported observationA2 and E (J=1) excited levels above A1 (J=0); values estimated from bulk susceptibility, approximately ±25 cm−1 accuracy.nischwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 12, printed p. 13216, IV.D.iv and reference 49
cited nickel ground multiplet excitation260 cm^-1reportedSource-reported observationA2 and E (J=1) excited levels above A1 (J=0); values estimated from bulk susceptibility, approximately ±25 cm−1 accuracy.nischwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 12, printed p. 13216, IV.D.iv and reference 49

ni ground state interpretationSpin–orbit coupling splits tetrahedral 3T1(F), leaving nondegenerate A1(J=0) and near-zero <Sz>. Magnetic-field-induced mixing with A2 and E produces weaker second-order Zeeman/B-term response without high-field saturation.author derivedSource-reported observationnischwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 12, printed p. 13216, IV.D.iv; schwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 13, printed p. 13217, Continuation
co mcd sum rule interpretationCo ligand-field integration has a small net negative sum-rule violation attributed primarily to out-of-state spin–orbit coupling with 4T2(F).author derivedSource-reported observationcoschwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 9, printed p. 13213, IV.D.i
ni mcd sum rule interpretationNet positive Ni ligand-field MCD violates the intensity sum rule, attributed to strong spin–orbit coupling within 3T1(F).author derivedSource-reported observationnischwartz2003 · Main PDF p. 9, printed p. 13213, IV.D.i
